options_evaluated: Monomaterial polymer housing (pure ABS or PC)
decisions.conflict: Manufacture and In-Service Agents recommend a die-cast/recycled aluminum housing for durability and low production emissions, while Material & Design and Circularity Agents recommend recycled or monomaterial polymers to optimize weight and recyclability.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 80: use or content of recycled materials
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (t), page 80: lightweight design through lower density or high-strength materials
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: ease and quality of recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Select a recycled Post-Consumer PC/ABS blend housing without co-molded elastomer grips. This meets lightweighting (t) and recycled content (h) mandates while ensuring the housing can be recycled without contamination (d). Aluminum is rejected due to excessive weight which compromises ergonomic functional performance.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the supply chain availability and mechanical properties of high-quality recycled PC/ABS blends to confirm they meet drop-test requirements without requiring fiberglass reinforcement.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal fasteners (screws) with threaded brass inserts
Snap-fit joints with standardized non-destructive fasteners
Permanent bonding (ultrasonic welding or chemical adhesives)
decisions.conflict: Material & Design Agent recommends snap-fit joints to simplify recycling, whereas In-Service and Circularity Agents recommend threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts to ensure durability over multiple disassembly and repair cycles.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, including ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment
decisions.chief_resolution: Implement threaded metal fasteners with threaded brass inserts. This ensures robust, non-destructive disassembly and reassembly (b) over multiple repair cycles, preventing housing damage that would lead to premature product disposal.
decisions.design_action: Verify the spatial envelope and wall-thickness requirements for integrating brass threaded inserts into the housing design to ensure structural integrity during assembly.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with recycled neodymium magnets and modular/replaceable assembly
Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with virgin neodymium magnets
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a brushed DC motor to minimize production energy and complexity, whereas In-Service, Circularity, and Material & Design Agents recommend a brushless DC motor to maximize durability, energy efficiency, and remanufacturability.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product, technical lifetime
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 80: use or content of recycled materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Adopt a Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with recycled neodymium magnets and modular windings. This maximizes the tool's durability and technical lifetime (a) and energy efficiency (g) during use, which outweighs initial manufacturing energy considerations.
decisions.design_action: Assess the commercial availability and magnetic performance consistency of recycled neodymium magnets from secondary raw material suppliers.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via optimized open vents and integrated aluminum heat sinks
Active cooling with a miniature electric fan
Phase change materials (PCM) or thermal potting encapsulation
decisions.conflict: Material & Design Agent recommends passive cooling through single-material housing vents to avoid multi-material separation issues, while In-Service and Circularity Agents recommend incorporating an aluminum heatsink to prevent thermal degradation of critical components.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability, resistance to stresses or ageing
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: ease and quality of recycling, non-destructive access to recyclable components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Select passive cooling via housing vents combined with a detachable aluminum heatsink. This prevents thermal degradation of the motor and battery (a) while ensuring the heatsink can be easily separated from the polymer housing for recycling (d), avoiding permanent potting compounds (e).
decisions.design_action: Investigate thermal dissipation requirements under peak load to determine if a detachable aluminum heatsink is required in addition to housing vents.

options_evaluated: Fully modular cartridge-based architecture with coded, non-destructively separable modules
Semi-modular architecture with soldered wire connections
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a monolithic monobloc design to simplify production and reduce assembly waste, whereas Material & Design, In-Service, and Circularity Agents demand a fully modular architecture to enable repair, upgrading, and component harvesting.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, modularity, ease of non-destructive disassembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (k), page 80: incorporation of used components
decisions.chief_resolution: Implement a fully modular cartridge-based architecture with coded, non-destructively separable modules. This directly satisfies regulatory mandates for ease of repair (b), remanufacturing (c), and component harvesting (k), outweighing the manufacturing simplicity of a monobloc design.
decisions.design_action: Investigate standardizing the internal electrical and mechanical interfaces between the battery, switch, and motor modules to ensure cross-compatibility.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with glueless mechanical assembly
Integrated (non-removable) or potted internal Li-ion battery pack
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a corded AC power supply to eliminate the manufacturing footprint of lithium-ion batteries, whereas Material & Design, In-Service, and Circularity Agents insist on a removable, standardized cordless battery pack to maintain portability and enable battery replacement.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (s), page 80: functional performance and conditions for use
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, availability of spare parts
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: ease and quality of recycling, non-destructive access to recyclable components
decisions.chief_resolution: Specify a removable, standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with glueless mechanical assembly. A corded option is rejected as it fails the core functional performance of a cordless tool (s). The removable, glueless pack ensures ease of repair (b) and high-quality cell recycling (d).
decisions.design_action: Verify the compatibility of the proposed slide-on battery interface with existing industry-standard battery platforms to maximize cross-brand usability.
